archiveTitle: 日报｜《战神：劳菲》延期至2027年5月20日

decisions.headline: 《战神：劳菲》延期至2027年5月20日
decisions.summary: 索尼互动娱乐与Santa Monica Studio把《战神：劳菲》的发售日从2027年2月16日推迟至5月20日；工作室表示需要更多时间达到玩家期待，并称将很快分享更多消息。
decisions.verification: IGN与Gematsu两家独立媒体均转述延期公告；新旧日期及工作室说明一致，未采用IGN对后续活动的猜测。
decisions.reason: 明确的第一方大作发售日变更，且有两家独立媒体提供一致的公告原文摘录。
decisions.timeNote: 以较早的Gematsu报道时间折算为北京时间；延期公告在本期窗口内公开。

decisions.verification: AUTOMATON、Famitsu与电ファミニコゲーマー三家报道均已打开，日期与延期原因同主条一致。
decisions.reason: 与9f70baf8898bc1606db1为同一《战神：劳菲》延期事件；并入证据更完整的英文双媒体包，避免重复。

decisions.headline: Xbox云游戏测试手机遥控与Nano手柄直连
decisions.summary: Xbox云游戏启动两项预览：受支持地区的智能电视可用Android或iOS手机浏览器充当手柄；美国用户可测试Nano手柄通过Wi-Fi直连云端会话。两项功能仍处测试期，设备与游戏支持范围有限。

decisions.region: Xbox Cloud Gaming支持地区；Nano手柄预览限美国

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | God of War Laufey Delayed to May 20, 2027

entries.headline: God of War Laufey delayed to May 20, 2027
entries.summary: Sony Interactive Entertainment and Santa Monica Studio moved the launch from February 16, 2027 to May 20. The studio said it needs more time to meet player expectations and will share more details soon.
entries.verification: IGN and Gematsu independently relayed the same studio notice. This entry excludes IGN speculation about future events.
entries.timeNote: Uses the earlier Gematsu report time, converted to Beijing time.

entries.headline: Ghost of Yotei: Most Wanted developers explain Jin Sakai’s return
entries.summary: Sucker Punch detailed how the team brought Jin Sakai into Most Wanted, using a class-based roguelike structure, prototypes, character detail, and animation work to preserve the character’s identity.
entries.verification: Opened the first-party PlayStation Blog developer feature and kept the summary within its stated design and production details.
entries.timeNote: PlayStation Blog publication time converted to Beijing time.

entries.headline: Xbox Cloud Gaming previews phone controls and direct-connect Nano controllers
entries.summary: Supported Smart TVs can use an Android or iOS phone browser as a controller in Xbox Cloud Gaming regions. US users can also test the Nano Controller’s Wi-Fi cloud connection. Both remain limited previews.
entries.verification: Opened Xbox Wire primary source and preserved the separate regional, device, and preview limitations.
entries.timeNote: Both previews began on the article’s publication date.
entries.regionLabel: Xbox Cloud Gaming markets; Nano preview limited to the United States

entries.headline: Action Game Maker G 2.1 adds macOS and Linux editors
entries.summary: Version 2.1 adds macOS and Linux editor support and export targets for iOS, macOS, and Linux. The macOS editor requires Apple silicon, and the Steam demo was extended through November 30.
entries.verification: Opened 4Gamer and Denfaminicogamer reports; the latter includes the company announcement text.
entries.timeNote: Uses the 4Gamer publication time in Beijing time; version 2.1 launched on November 4.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: Ocarina of Time remake holds a 96 Metacritic average in an 80-review snapshot
entries.summary: Denfaminicogamer reported that the Nintendo Switch 2 remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time had a 96 Metacritic average from 80 reviews at publication time. The score may change as more reviews arrive.
entries.verification: Opened the report and treated both the score and review count as a time-bounded snapshot, not a permanent ranking.
entries.timeNote: Snapshot reported on November 4; the game was scheduled for November 5.

sourceLabels.label: 電ファミニコゲーマー News

entries.headline: NIKKE investigates possible tampering with its PC launcher script
entries.summary: The operator said a third party may have altered a PC launcher script. A client fix and update went out around 02:30 on November 4, while the impact remains under investigation.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON’s report with the official notice excerpt. “Possible” and “under investigation” remain explicit.
entries.timeNote: The fix was reported at about 02:30 Beijing time; the article was published at 11:48.

entries.headline: World of Warcraft Forever opens its live servers
entries.summary: The servers opened at 3 PM PST / 6 PM EST. IGN’s live log said login issues were easing several hours in, while faction limits and crowded quest areas remained. That assessment reflects the outlet’s observation at the time.
entries.verification: Opened IGN’s launch live blog and used only the stated opening time and bounded live observations.
entries.timeNote: Launch time converts to 07:00 Beijing time on November 5; article time was 08:37.

entries.headline: Pokemon Pokopia: Dazzling Decorations DLC launches December 9
entries.summary: The paid Expansion Pass Part 2 adds accessories, furniture, and more Pokemon on December 9. The announcement says it will not add a new town.
entries.verification: Opened Gematsu’s relay of the publisher and developer announcement and official-site details.
entries.timeNote: Report time converted to Beijing time; DLC date is December 9.

entries.headline: Action tower-defense game SKULD releases a Steam demo
entries.summary: Develup Games released a Steam demo for Super Monkey Studio’s SKULD, an action tower-defense game about a Valkyrie using weapons and turrets against enemy hordes.
entries.verification: Opened the 4Gamer report and retained only the demo status, named companies, and gameplay outline.
entries.timeNote: Published at 13:33 Beijing time on November 4.

entries.headline: Mobile game Disney Sparkling Stars begins service
entries.summary: coly launched the free-to-play mobile game with in-app purchases. It is set on the Sparkle Islands of Luminastea and centers on raising Spark Riders.
entries.verification: Opened the 4Gamer report. The English rendering follows the Japanese title’s romanization and is not asserted as an official English title.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:34 Beijing time on November 4.

entries.headline: Midnight Rest Stop releases a Steam demo
entries.summary: RAYBIS GAMES released a Steam demo for the psychological horror title set at a remote Japanese rest stop in 1988. The full game is scheduled for November 13.
entries.verification: Opened the 4Gamer report and preserved the demo status, setting, and full-release date.
entries.timeNote: Published at 18:09 Beijing time on November 4; full release is scheduled for November 13.
